title: ChatMe!
description: ChatMe! is a lightweight Minecraft 1.21.4 plugin that lets servers send messages, notifications, and reminders to both online and offline players, storing missed messages in a database for delivery when they next log in. It includes /inbox.
body:
ChatMe is a powerful, lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to improve player communication by delivering messages, notifications, and reminders to players regardless of their online status. Using a robust database-backed system (SQLite by default, with optional MySQL support), ChatMe stores offline messages securely and delivers them automatically when players reconnect, ensuring no important information is missed.

Admins can easily schedule one-time or recurring reminders and broadcast notifications to individuals, groups, or the entire server, with full command and permission management. Players can conveniently access their unread messages anytime with the /inbox command.

Seamless integration with PlaceholderAPI allows server owners to display real-time message statistics, like unread message counts and indicators, in HUDs, scoreboards, or chat. The plugin offers extensive configuration options including message formatting, expiration timing, database selection, and cleanup schedules, making it adaptable to any server size or style.

Built for Minecraft 1.21.4 with forward compatibility in mind, ChatMe is optimized for performance on large multiplayer servers and fully compatible with singleplayer worlds. Its modular architecture facilitates easy maintenance and expansion to future Minecraft versions.
